question: Does the repository approve this workflow’s pull_request_target-triggered, cross-repository GitHub App token boundary after reviewing the full event filters and dispatch payload?
rationale: The workflow’s intended behavior requires privileged cross-repository dispatch; whether its filtering and token scope are acceptable is a repository security decision rather than a mechanical contributor repair.

options.title: Review filters and prove dispatch
options.body: Recommended: confirm the full workflow only forwards intended event data, then attach a redacted allowed-versus-filtered live dispatch run before merge.

options.title: Accept the standardized rollout boundary
options.body: Approve the existing scoped App-token design if maintainers confirm it matches the organization-wide ClawSweeper security model.

options.title: Pause for a narrower design
options.body: Hold the PR if Crabbox should not use pull_request_target or a cross-repository write-capable dispatcher token.

recommendation.title: Review filters and prove dispatch
recommendation.body: Recommended: confirm the full workflow only forwards intended event data, then attach a redacted allowed-versus-filtered live dispatch run before merge.

likelyOwner.reason: This contributor is the only evidenced owner of the cited organization-wide dispatcher rollout in the supplied context.
